overview_description.description: Provi is the largest online marketplace that simplifies the complex process of ordering wholesale alcohol by connecting buyers, distributors and suppliers. Active in key markets throughout the U.S., Provi's robust, online marketplace improves communication and efficiency for on- and off-premise buyers, distributors and suppliers. As of 2022, 10 percent of licensed retailers in the U.S. are on the marketplace. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Chicago, Provi has received a total of $125 million in funding, is valued at $750 million and has recently been named an Emerging Unicorn by Crunchbase. The company also received Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work recognition in 2022. In 2022, Provi joined forces with SevenFifty.

press_references.value: Provi and Southern Glazer’s provisionally settle an antitrust lawsuit

legal_proceedings.description: Provi has reached a provisional settlement in its antitrust lawsuit against Southern Glazer's Wine & Spirits. The lawsuit, filed in March 2022, accused Southern Glazer's and Republic National Distributing Company (RNDC) of conspiring to boycott Provi's platform to favor their own systems. The case, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois Eastern Division, proceeded after a judge denied dismissal motions in May 2024. While Provi and Southern Glazer's have agreed to pause proceedings to finalize the settlement, RNDC remains a defendant, and litigation continues against them.
